headline: Breaking! IHSG Opens Down 1% Right Away
summary: The IHSG opened weaker at 5,152.16 on Friday 20 November 2026. Trading volume in the early session reached 5.34 million lots.
why: The IHSG is Indonesia's main stock index, tracking the Indonesia Stock Exchange. Opening moves signal early sentiment for domestic equities.
why_moved: The index opened lower with early trading volume of 5.34 million lots, indicating selling pressure at the open.
